seo.title: BioPlex 2200 — Bio-Rad multiplex system | LabWell
seo.description: BioPlex 2200 is an automated Bio-Rad multiplex system processing up to 100 samples/hour for autoimmune and infectious disease testing. Supplied by LabWell.

T2_hero.lead: An automated random-access Bio-Rad platform for autoimmune, infectious disease, and specialty immunoassay testing.

T3_about.h2: What BioPlex 2200 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: BioPlex 2200 System is a fully automated Bio-Rad system for multiplex immunoassays. It consolidates autoimmune and infectious disease testing on one platform and suits laboratories that need to measure several markers within a single test. Random and continuous access allows STAT samples to be loaded as a priority.

rows.label: Operational mode
rows.value: Random and continuous access with priority STAT loading

items.text: The multiplex format measures several markers within a single test. This can reduce the number of separate runs needed for autoimmune and infectious disease panels.
Samples, consumables, and waste remain accessible during processing. Priority STAT loading is available for urgent samples.
According to the manufacturer, the menu includes more than 50 assays for autoimmune disease, infectious disease, and specialty immunoassay testing.

T6_items.footnote: Ask a LabWell manager to confirm the configuration and availability of individual entries in Ukraine.

items.q: What is the throughput of BioPlex 2200?
items.a: It processes up to 100 samples per hour, with the first result in less than 45 minutes depending on the panel.

items.q: What sample types can BioPlex 2200 process?
items.a: It can process serum, plasma, or CSF depending on the assay. Sample volume starts at 5 µL.

items.q: Which tests are available for BioPlex 2200?
items.a: According to the manufacturer, the menu includes more than 50 assays for autoimmune disease, infectious disease, and specialty immunoassays.

items.q: Can urgent samples be added during operation?
items.a: Yes. The system provides random and continuous access with priority STAT loading.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains BioPlex 2200 in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.

T12_contact.text: Tell us which panels and sample workload you need, and we will help assess whether BioPlex 2200 fits your laboratory.
